data.name: ProfileRevisionHelp
data.value: Each saved revision shows its profile ID, snapshot ID and file kind. Listings remain unverified until authenticated opening.

data.name: ProfileSavedReferenceHelp
data.value: Reference for the last successfully installed encrypted profile save. Keep these identifiers and ciphertext digest separately from the vault. This receipt alone does not verify recovery.

data.name: ProfileModeCompareOnly
data.value: Compare only: public values and stripped structure; no recoverable secrets. Public values may still be private operational data.

data.name: ProfileModeImportUpgradeOnly
data.value: Import and upgrade only: encrypted retained values cannot be revealed, copied, previewed or restored by undo. Local authorized decoders can still decrypt them.

data.name: ProfileModeInspectableEncrypted
data.value: Inspectable encrypted: opening restores answers for ordinary editing and inspection.

data.name: ProfileModeUnencryptedTarget
data.value: Unencrypted target output: use Review to deliberately prepare and save restricted target files.

data.name: ProfileCreateDevice
data.value: Create a new OS keyring recipient

data.name: ProfileDeviceWarning
data.value: Keyring, account or device loss can permanently prevent recovery. Add a portable passphrase recipient and check it independently. A failed lookup never creates a replacement.

data.name: ProfileDeviceAcknowledgement
data.value: I accept permanent loss if I save without portable recovery and lose the device recipient.

data.name: ProfilePassphrase
data.value: Portable passphrase (new recipients require at least 15 Unicode characters)

data.name: ProfileRecipientIndex
data.value: One selected recipient index (device is index zero when configured)

data.name: ProfileCompare
data.value: Compare public baseline or review upgrade

data.name: ProfileRecoveryCheck
data.value: Check selected revision using portable recipient alone

data.name: ProfileRetained
data.value: Retained fields contain no displayed values. Select a field to retire before entering its replacement. Upgrade facts are advisory and require revalidation.

data.name: ProfileConfirmReplacement
data.value: Confirm permanent retirement of this retained field, including from undo.

data.name: ProfilePrepareOutput
data.value: Compose retained values and save selected target output directly

data.name: ProfileRecoveryHelp
data.value: After saving, list and select that exact revision. Select the portable recipient and enter its passphrase. Verification uses a fresh context without the device key and covers only this revision. An opened historical copy without a trusted saved reference remains unverified.

data.name: ProfileRekeyHelp
data.value: Saving an opened profile preserves its mode and creates a fresh snapshot with new encryption keys and nonce. Old copies retain old access. This does not rotate target credentials.

data.name: ProfileUninstallHelp
data.value: A vault copy is insufficient without a working recipient. Reinstall and support cannot reconstruct lost keys. Uninstall or reset may leave files or keyring entries, but preservation is not guaranteed.

data.name: ProfileStatusHelp
data.value: Technical status below reports the operation. Locked, denied or missing keyring access requires explicit portable recipient selection and retry; there is no automatic fallback. Installation, verification and cleanup are separate facts.

data.name: SingleFileNameHelp
data.value: A single output uses this filename.

data.name: MultipleFileNamesHelp
data.value: Multiple outputs use their declared filenames.

data.name: OptionalImport
data.value: Compare or fill from an existing file

data.name: DiscoveryHelp
data.value: Search public setting metadata, up to 256 characters and 16 terms. Answers and private entry names are excluded.

data.name: DiscoveryLimit
data.value: Use at most 256 characters and 16 search terms.

data.name: DiscoveryInactive
data.value: This setting is inactive in the current configuration. Change its controlling settings deliberately if needed.

data.name: DiscoveryUnavailable
data.value: Open the containing setting and choose an existing entry. Search does not supply optional containers or choose private entries.

data.name: SupplyHelp
data.value: Supply this container, preserving existing contents and declared initialization.

data.name: ClearHelp
data.value: Omit this answer. A string list item is reset to an empty string; use Remove item to remove its row.

data.name: ResetHelp
data.value: Remove the override and omission so declared initialization can apply. This does not copy an initialized value into supplied answers.

data.name: ImportLimitHelp
data.value: Local input, at most 4 MiB. Compare leaves current answers, drafts and prepared output untouched. Fill fields is deliberate and atomic.
